description: Mark that the worker is on the way to a visit, with an optional ETA (eta_at, or eta_minutes from now). The worker on the visit (or the office) can do this. When the shop has on the way notices on, the customer gets a text and an email. Text is the main one. The email goes whenever the customer has an email address, even if the text is blocked, refused, or does not go through. When arrival notices are also on, the message includes an arrival time: a route estimate when the visit already has one, otherwise the time the worker entered, otherwise no arrival line. Route data stores the booked start and the arrival window, not a drive time. Doing Work does not look up a drive time.
name: visits_onTheWay

customer_notice.description: Whether a customer notice was queued. On the way, that is the on the way message. Arrived, that is the arrived message when arrival notices are on. It is sent only if the customer can be reached.
